subject: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchid.ai>, procurement@orchid.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options

Hi Samira —

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I've attached a short usage summary (orchid_usage_summary_q3.csv) and an ROI recap that models a couple of term options. High-level observations:

- Baseline token burn: ~420M tokens/month (90% chat, 10% embeddings).
- Peak windows: 18:00–22:00 PT show a 2.8x spike on weekdays (prefetchable patterns).
- KV cache hit rates are already ~55% for your primary user flows; there's room to lift this with modest prompt standardization.

Recommendations (short):
1) Bucketization: split committed capacity into 2 buckets — 350M committed + 100M prefunded burst credits for predictable headroom. Reduces overage volatility and constrains unit economics.
2) Rollforward clause: a quarterly true-up for the first 3 quarters so we can rebalance the committed bucket based on observed cadence.
3) Pilot: enable a 30% prefetch cache on NLU-heavy routes for 6 weeks (we estimate 12–18% token reduction).

Next steps I propose: 30-minute sync with procurement and ops to convert recommendation into PO-line items + finalize SOW draft. I've attached the ROI PDF and a SOW draft seed.

Available windows: Tue/Wed morning PT — what works for you?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: orchid_usage_summary_q3.csv, roi-recap-2027.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchid.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@orchid.ai
Date: 2027-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options

Thanks Ava — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying asks from our side before we pull procurement in formally:

- Can you provide PO-ready line items for both the committed bucket and the prefunded burst credits (unit price + term)?
- Confirm SLA targets (p50/p95 latency) for the primary model variant during peak windows and whether the burst lane guarantees apply across regions.

Procurement: procurement@orchid.ai — please advise on our PO cadence.

I can do Wed 9:30 PT for a short sync.

—Samira
Head of Platform | Orchid AI
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchid.ai>, procurement@orchid.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options

Samira — great, thanks. Quick responses inline: 

- PO line items: see the pricing sheet in the shared Drive (link below). I'll also attach a one-page PO template after the call so procurement has a copy. Line-item examples:
  • Committed bucket (12-mo): 350,000,000 tokens/mo @ $0.0009/token
  • Prefunded burst credits (one-time top-up): 100,000,000 tokens @ $0.00075/token (discounted)
  • Optional: 6-week prefetch pilot add-on (flat fee $6,000)

- SLA: We guarantee p50 latency < 120ms and p95 < 420ms for the pinned model variant in us-west region under committed capacity. Burst lane is best-effort but we provide routing priority and 99% availability under our Dedicated offering; we'll include an explicit fallback policy in the SOW.

I've uploaded a SOW seed (SOW-draft-Orchid.docx) and the PO template to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchid-pricing

Call confirmed: Wed 2027-12-01 09:30 PT. I'll invite ops and product.

Attachments: SOW-draft-Orchid.docx

Regards,
Ava
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@orchid.ai>
Date: 2027-12-02T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options

Looping in operational ask — happy to approve a temporary 10% prefunded burst credit top-up for the pilot (covers first 6 weeks) if Orchid will commit to the quarterly true-up cadence. A few operational notes:

- We'll enable a canary rollout for the prefetch config to limit risk (10% traffic initial).
- Recommend instrumenting a small eval set to measure quality regression from quantization/prefetch changes (Ben will share eval harness).
- If Orchid wants a firm burst SLA we can discuss a Dedicated lane addendum; otherwise it's priority routing only.

Ben
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchid.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orchid.ai
Date: 2027-12-07T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Headroom econ — bucketization & rollforward options

Appreciate the fast follow, everyone. The plan looks reasonable and aligns with what we'll present at exec. Two items from procurement:

1) Can Redwood issue a DocuSign link with the 12-mo committed bucket + 100M prefunded burst credits and the 6-week pilot as an addendum?
2) We need a one-week extension on the PO deadline to allow legal to review the fallback SLA language.

If you can send the DocuSign link and update the PO expiry to 2027-12-15, I'll route to legal and procurement.

Thanks — Samira

--
Samira Khan | Head of Platform, Orchid AI
procurement@orchid.ai
